final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM circuits AS c JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.location), shares AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_count * 1.0 / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts) SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM shares WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ()
